page.layout: One page of handwritten manuscript annotation, centred in the upper half, with a signature below. No printed text block. A library stamp sits lower left and is excluded.

main_text.p:
Liber rarus est, essi rogo dignus
vide
Anonymum in XV. Theil der
Vrgeguging
ndusdigen Dʀundrmᴇ pag.
215.

page.notes: The whole page is handwritten ink, not print. The text above is a best reading of the cursive: the first line reads "Liber rarus est, esse rogo dignus" as far as legible. Lines 3 to 5 ("Anonymum im XV. Theil der", "Vrgeguging", "nudsdigen Drudrme pag.") are uncertain and marked here as doubtful; the second word of line 5 and the word after "Vrgeguging" could not be read with certainty. The name in the signature ("Rüblingensis") is doubtful. A round Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München stamp is present and was left out.
